rule Suspicious_PowerShell_From_Outlook {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell launched directly from Outlook process"
        threat_level = 3
        malware_family = "Phishing Payload"
        attack = "T1566.001, T1059.001"
    strings:
        $powershell_exe = "powershell.exe" fullword ascii
        $outlook_proc = "outlook.exe" fullword ascii
    condition:
        startup_info.ImageFileName matches /outlook\.exe/i and
        pe.exports("CreateProcess") and
        $powershell_exe in (pe.imports("kernel32.dll", "CreateProcess*"))
}
